definitions.gloss: advisor; counselor; person who gives advice
definitions.explanation: A person who provides guidance, suggestions, or recommendations. Used in both formal institutional settings and general contexts.

examples.japanese: {信頼|しんらい}できる{助言者|じょげんしゃ}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
{彼|かれ}は{若|わか}い{起業家|きぎょうか}にとって{良|よ}き{助言者|じょげんしゃ}だった。
examples.english: He was a good advisor to the young entrepreneur.

examples.japanese: {外部|がいぶ}の{助言者|じょげんしゃ}を{招|まね}いて{経営|けいえい}{戦略|せんりゃく}を{見直|みなお}すことにした。
examples.english: We decided to invite an external advisor to review the management strategy.

notes:
Compound of {助言|じょげん} (advice) + {者|しゃ} (person). A relatively formal word for someone in an advisory role.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {外部|がいぶ}{助言者|じょげんしゃ}: external advisor
- {法律|ほうりつ}{助言者|じょげんしゃ}: legal advisor
- {良|よ}き{助言者|じょげんしゃ}: good advisor
- {助言者|じょげんしゃ}として: in the capacity of advisor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- アドバイザー: advisor (loanword) — more common in business and casual contexts
- {顧問|こもん}: consultant; advisor — typically a formal, sometimes honorary position in organizations
- {相談役|そうだんやく}: consultant; senior advisor — often a post-retirement advisory position in Japanese companies
- カウンセラー: counselor — typically for personal, psychological, or career guidance
